<!--

Made updates to the way HA talks to Azure Event Hub, fixing several items, and it adds connection string based creation of Event Hub connections, in addition to the model with a namespace, instance and SAS policy and key, this enables IoT Hub connections to be made with this integration as well.

  the configuration would look like.
  Note: Remove this section if this PR does not have an example entry.
-->

```yaml
# Example configuration.yaml
azure_event_hub:
  event_hub_namespace: NAMESPACE_NAME
  event_hub_instance_name: EVENT_HUB_INSTANCE_NAME
  event_hub_sas_policy: SAS_POLICY_NAME
  event_hub_sas_key: SAS_KEY
  send_interval: 5
  max_delay: 30
  filter:
    include_domains:
    - homeassistant
    - light
    - media_player

# New alternative config
azure_event_hub:
  event_hub_connection_string: CONNECTION_STRING
  send_interval: 5
  max_delay: 30
  filter:
    include_domains:
    - homeassistant
    - light
    - media_player

```

issue_context.title: Azure Event Hub - SAS Token
issue_context.body:
0.95.4 - Azure Event Hub


The parameter "event_hub_sas_key" is generated automatically by Azure and can contain special characters eg + (plus sign), this will make the component fail and not sending data. Resetting the SAS token resolves the problem.
